episode.title: Wide Awake
episode.scene: Late evening in the living room under the warm amber glow of a low table lamp. Teddy, large and shaggy with apricot fur, sits upright on the wooden floor holding a single sunflower seed between his stubby paws, gazing down with a calm, deadpan expression. Pressed against his soft flank is Ichigo, who has collapsed into deep sleep mid-gesture, her tiny white body slumped sideways with her snout buried into his fur and one little front paw still rigidly raised in the air.
episode.caption: She had four more very important points to make.
episode.arcNote: Ichigo vigorously insisted she was wide awake before instantly collapsing asleep against Teddy mid-sentence.
episode.arcUpdate: Content in their evening routines, with Ichigo unable to out-stubborn basic exhaustion.
